headlines.title: Healey to promise 'new age of industrialisation' for UK in conference speech
headlines.description: The chancellor will unveil policies aimed at boosting British shipbuilding in his speech to Labour's annual conference on Monday.

headlines.title: Avanti West Coast services to be nationalised from March
headlines.description: The move is part of a plan to improve rail infrastructure, cut train delays and improve experiences for passengers.

headlines.title: Heathrow Airport warns third runway could be delayed by four years
headlines.description: The UK's busiest airport cautions it may miss the government target of 2035 as ministers say the deadline has "always been ambitious".

headlines.title: US backs Elon Musk's bid to overturn €120m EU fine against X
headlines.description: The EU had said X "deceives users" by selling blue ticks without "meaningfully verifying" accounts.

headlines.title: UK diesel price close to all-time high
headlines.description: The average price of a litre of diesel at the pump stands at 198.32p, according to the RAC motoring body.
